# Overview

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "bbfm",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Implementation = "bbfm-implementation.html",
    Theory = "bbfm-theory.html"
  )
)
```

```{r bbfm_overview, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_overview(
  family = "bbfm",
  summary = paste(
    "The body-backbone fish model (`BBFM`) is a composite model for",
    "swimbladder-less fish in which the flesh body and an elastic backbone are",
    "retained as separate acoustic components."
  ),
  core_idea = paste(
    "Calculate the flesh-body contribution with `DWBA`, calculate the backbone",
    "with `ECMS`, translate both amplitudes into one body-fixed phase reference,",
    "and add them coherently. This separates mechanisms emphasized in",
    "swimbladder-less fish models [@Gorska_2005; @Stanton_1998_1]."
  ),
  best_for = c(
    "Swimbladder-less fish with explicit body and backbone geometry",
    "Studying interference between weak-fluid flesh and an elastic internal component",
    "A transparent first-order composite approximation before a coupled solver is available"
  ),
  supports = c(
    "`BBF` objects constructed from separate body and backbone `Shape` objects",
    "Fluid-like body properties and elastic backbone density and wave speeds",
    "Stored body, backbone, phase-shifted, and combined outputs"
  ),
  assumptions = c(
    "The flesh remains within the `DWBA` weak-scattering regime",
    "The backbone is represented by the canonical `ECMS` cylinder solution",
    "Centroid translation is sufficient to place the component phases",
    "No shadowing, repeated rescattering, or coupled embedded-cylinder boundary solve"
  ),
  reading = c(
    "[Implementation](bbfm-implementation.html): constructing `BBF` objects, component output, and reconstruction checks",
    "[Theory](bbfm-theory.html): component amplitudes, phase translation, and interference",
    "[Combining components](../combining-components/combining-components.html): requirements for coherent and incoherent sums"
  )
)
```
